data.title: 久岛鸥 · 海蚀洞窟的篝火夜话
data.description: 避风海蚀洞窟内，潮声回荡。中央生起一堆噼啪作响的篝火，鸥裹着薄毯盘腿坐在干草铺上，手握小树枝拨动火星，兴致勃勃地讲述古老航海传说。
data.location: sheltered sea cave cavern with opening framing a moonlit night ocean tide
data.action: sitting cross-legged by a crackling campfire, gesturing with a small stick, golden eyes lit up by firelight as she narrates tales
data.lighting: 篝火跳跃火光与洞口清冷月华
data.promptProse: Kamome sits beside a cozy campfire inside a coastal sea cave, animatedly recounting pirate legends by the dancing firelight.
data.animaCaption: Flickering campfire flames illuminate the rough cave walls and her glowing yellow eyes.
